limitations.description: The out-of-fold data-generation provenance has not been independently verified.
limitations.interpretation: The available persisted reports do not establish independent research-grade, leakage-free calibration fitting.

limitations.description: The Validation comparison reports improved ECE and MCE, but slightly worsened log loss and multiclass Brier score.
limitations.interpretation: Calibration must not be described as improving every probability-quality metric.

limitations.description: Accuracy and classification error count remained unchanged in the persisted comparison.
limitations.interpretation: The reported calibration changes concern probability quality, not a change in predicted class decisions.

evaluation_interpretation.ece: Improved in the persisted Validation comparison: approximately 0.000791 to 0.000683.
evaluation_interpretation.mce: Improved in the persisted Validation comparison: approximately 0.572443 to 0.553663.
evaluation_interpretation.overall_conclusion: The reported calibration-error metrics improved, but log loss and multiclass Brier score worsened slightly. The results do not support an unqualified claim that calibration improved every measure of probability quality.

approval_statement: Operational artifact verification does not establish research-grade leakage-free approval. OOF provenance remains unverified.
